text: Both models get scored on the validation set from lesson 11's split. Logistic Regression lands at 0.831 AUC -- solid. LightGBM comes back at 0.978.
Felix calls it the best model he's shipped. Dana asks if that number seems almost too good -- the feature importances track with intuition, so the room moves on.
An AUC score doesn't tell Tom's team who to call this week. Precision and recall across candidate thresholds turn the ranked score into an actual decision.
The threshold gets chosen on real dollars: a missed renewal costs roughly $14,400, an unnecessary outreach call costs about $150. That gap pulls the cutoff down to 0.3.
Both models, the chosen threshold, and the cost assumptions are documented and handed off. The reserved test set stays untouched. Next: explaining what's actually driving these scores.
